# U148: Proposed in a review: as Rhea walking Developer Productivity fortnightly, “Propose a new goal” (on a phone, “Propose a new goal instead” in the next-step sheet) on Lead time for changes opens a sheet that starts with Rhea (the goal’s owner) and Lead time for changes; a name and Camille as owner saves a proposed goal for Camille in that review, not on the agenda; Camille’s Home says “Rhea proposed a goal for you in Developer Productivity fortnightly”; the review’s next session’s Last time reads “Proposed: … Camille hasn’t made it active yet.”

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `GOAL-PROPOSED`
- **Budget:** at most 30 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/goals/ns-lead?review=devprod&today={day}` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U148

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/goals/ns-lead?review=devprod&today={day}` in the demo.
- _Note:_ On a phone the decide bar keeps to its height (RV 4), so the link lives in the next-step sheet instead.
- If on a phone:
  - _Note:_ A goal behind asks for its next step first; one that isn't offers "Add an action". Either opens the same sheet.
  - **Check:** The decide (`.decide`) shows.
  - **Step.** Press it.
  - **Step.** Press the “Propose a new goal instead” button.
- Otherwise:
  - **Step.** Press the “Propose a new goal” button.
- **Check:** The “Propose a new goal” dialog shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) the “Who will own it?: Rhea Kapoor” button in the “Propose a new goal” dialog is visible and the “It will feed: Lead time for changes” button in the “Propose a new goal” dialog is visible (else: the sheet doesn’t start with the goal on screen’s owner and the goal itself).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “propose”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Propose it” button in the “Propose a new goal” dialog.
- **Check:** “Give the goal a name.” is shown in the “Propose a new goal” dialog (else: Propose it with no name doesn’t say what to fix).
- **Step.** Type “Data-backed environments ready in under an hour” into the “What should the goal be called?” field in the “Propose a new goal” dialog.
- Find and pick: press “Who will own it” in the “Propose a new goal” dialog, type “camille”, and choose “Camille”.
- **Step.** Press the “Propose it” button in the “Propose a new goal” dialog.
- **Check:** “Proposed “Data-backed environments ready in under an hour”” is shown (else: proposing in the review says nothing).
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `!!made && made.proposedIn === 'devprod' && made.ownerId === 'camille' && !!made.proposedAt && made.parentId === 'ns-lead'`, where `const title = 'Data-backed environments ready in under an hour'`; `const snap = await h.snapshot()`; `const made = snap.goals.find((g) => g.title === title)`. Else it says: the goal wasn’t saved proposed, for Camille, in Developer Productivity fortnightly, feeding Lead time for changes.
- _Note:_ Something said in the session, so it is held this week.
- **Step.** Press the “Add a note” button.
- **Step.** Type “Agreed to propose a goal for data-backed environments.” into the “Your note” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Save note” button.
- **Check:** “Note saved” is shown (else: the note wasn’t saved).
- Go to `/reviews/devprod?today={day}` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `!(await p.locator('[data-part="Still to review"]').innerText().catch(() => '')).includes(title)`, where `const title = 'Data-backed environments ready in under an hour'`. Else it says: the proposed goal is on the review’s agenda.
- _Note:_ Camille's Home says where it came from.
- Go to `/?today={day}` in the demo.
- **Step.** Switch to Camille in the Demo panel (the quiet Demo button): a role card’s person, or anyone else by typing their name.
- **Check:** “Rhea proposed a goal for you in Developer Productivity fortnightly” is shown (else: Camille’s Home doesn’t say the goal was proposed in the review).
- _Note:_ The next session's Last time names it.
- **Step.** Switch to Rhea in the Demo panel (the quiet Demo button): a role card’s person, or anyone else by typing their name.
- Go to `/reviews/devprod` in the demo on Wednesday 25 November 2026.
- **Check:** The “Last time” part (`[data-part="Last time"]`) shows.
- **Check:** “Proposed: Data-backed environments ready in under an hour ({made?.key}). Camille hasn’t made it active yet.” is shown in the “Last time” part (`[data-part="Last time"]`) (else: the next session’s Last time doesn’t name the goal proposed in it).
